notes.upstream:
Release v1.100.58 (Chromium 158.0.8127.42)

# Android

Pick the `APK` suitable for your device's architecture.

# iOS

`brave-core-ios-1.100.58.*` contains Brave for iOS.

# Linux

`DEB` and `RPM` packages attached below, details at https://brave.com/linux

# macOS

`Brave-*-*.dmg` or `Brave-*-*.pkg` will install this version.
macOS 12 and above are supported as per https://support.brave.app/hc/en-us/articles/360021357112-What-are-the-system-requirements-to-install-Brave

# Windows

`Brave*Setup.exe` will fetch and install the latest available version for your CPU architecture from our update servers.
Windows 10 and above are supported as per https://support.brave.app/hc/en-us/articles/360021357112-What-are-the-system-requirements-to-install-Brave

# Release Notes

 - Added support for on-device WebSpeech API for English (being rolled out in phases using Griffin starting at 25%). ([#56487](https://github.com/brave/brave-browser/issues/56487))
 - [Security] Updated various sync "datatype" values to "EncryptableUserTypes". ([#61788](https://github.com/brave/brave-browser/issues/61788))
 - Updated AI Chat models. ([#59884](https://github.com/brave/brave-browser/issues/59884))
 - Updated UI polish for various icons, colors, and spacing. ([#60161](https://github.com/brave/brave-browser/issues/60161))
 - Updated split view UI for stacked mode. ([#59845](https://github.com/brave/brave-browser/issues/59845))
 - Fixed issue where ".onion" domains could be leaked as reported on HackerOne by newfunction. ([#59801](https://github.com/brave/brave-browser/issues/59801))
 - Fixed crash which occurred when the ability to set Brave as default browser was disabled via Admin policy on Linux. ([#60038](https://github.com/brave/brave-browser/issues/60038))
 - Fixed an issue where using "Add Tab to New Split View" on a tab in a container did not open the split view tab in the same container. ([#59951](https://github.com/brave/brave-browser/issues/59951))
 - Fixed an issue where https://play.xbox.com and other sites that require viewport size request headers would fail to load. ([#61705](https://github.com/brave/brave-browser/issues/61705))
 - Upgraded Chromium to 158.0.8127.42. ([#61954](https://github.com/brave/brave-browser/issues/61954)) ([Changelog for 158.0.8127.42](https://chromium.googlesource.com/chromium/src/+log/157.0.8103.79..158.0.8127.42?pretty=fuller&n=1000))
